item.title: EA Officially Shuts Down BioWare and Cancels Next Mass Effect Game: The Fall of an RPG Titan (2026)
item.description: Electronic Arts (EA) has officially shuttered legendary RPG studio BioWare after 31 years of operation, terminating all development on the upcoming Mass Effect sequel (Mass Effect 5). The decision follows widespread corporate restructuring, commercial underperformance of Dragon Age: The Veilguard, and broader financial pressures across the gaming industry.
